Role: Gen AI Data Scientist

Location: Noida/Gurugram/Delhi

Type: Hybrid

Job Description




We are hiring a Gen AI Data Scientist with strong expertise in Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs). The candidate will work on developing AI-powered intelligent solutions, enterprise GenAI applications, and advanced analytics use cases.




Roles and Responsibilities


Build and deploy Generative AI and Machine Learning solutions.
Develop LLM-based applications using RAG architecture.
Work on prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
Fine-tune and optimize AI models for business use cases.
Develop scalable AI solutions using Python and cloud platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI-driven products.
Integrate GenAI models with APIs and enterprise systems.
Ensure model performance, scalability, and responsible AI practices.


Desired Candidate Profile


3+ years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering or a related field.
Experience working with Large Language Models like GEN AI or similar technologies.
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and ability to apply them in real-world scenarios.
Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python and familiarity with SQL.
